summary: Dirk Anderson, 54, died in a backcountry motorcycle crash in Bangs Canyon on the Tabeguache Trail above Grand Junction; launched over a chasm, struck a rock outcrop and fell ~80 ft into an alcove, succumbing to internal injuries.
location: Bangs Canyon, Tabeguache Trail, above Grand Junction
notes: Rock and Ice 'Climbers We Lost in 2019' (2020-01-06, Wayback snapshot): Anderson completed all Colorado 14ers solo Aug 24, 2018, then all with his brother exactly a year later; on Aug 30, 2019 he left for a short backcountry motorcycle ride on the Bangs Canyon section of Tabeguache Trail above Grand Junction, sped off over a chasm, slammed a rock outcrop and was thrown back down an 80-ft cliff into an alcove; survived the initial fall, succumbed to internal injuries. The tribute also links a Colorado Sun obituary (2019-09-19) that was not verifiable from here: https://coloradosun.com/2019/09/19/loki-outdoor-gear-dirk-seth-anderson/
